text:
maya: Quick decision thread  need to finalize reserved-pool + burst policy for next release. Short answers preferred.
omar: Proposal: baseline = hard guarantee; burst = preemptible, token-bucket per-tenant, hard monthly spend cap.
lucy: Runtime notes: allow in-flight session completion on preemption, block new sessions when burst exhausted. Need feature flag.
ben: SRE: sims show unbounded burst kills p99. Recommend cap by tokens + a per-tenant ceiling.
ben: sim config used: capacity=400, refill=40/min gave stable p99 in mixed workloads.
alia: Sales ask: pilots want 7-10% carryover. Suggest offer as paid add-on with 30d expiry.
legal: Billing clause draft: baseline billed as reserved; burst metered per-second, invoice rounded per-minute; customers can set hard spend caps.
omar: UX decision: on token exhaustion do immediate 429 + Retry-After (no queueing). Customers prefer predictable fast-fail.
lucy: Engineering aligns with immediate reject. Will surface helpful error message and fallback model suggestion.
ben: I'll run an extra multi-tenant storm sim and share numbers by EOD.
sre-bot: queued sim id=7012 config="cap=400,refill=40/m", eta=2026-06-10T02:00:00Z
maya: Launch criteria we agree on: 3 pilots canary, p95 regression <8%, <=3 escalations in 30d, billing docs published.
ol: typo: meant lucy not ol :)
omar: Next steps: lucy -> feature flag PR by 2026-06-01; ben -> sim results by 2026-05-27; maya -> draft pilot contract; alia -> pilot customer list.
lucy: Adding KV cache tags and session-drain hooks to tickets.
ben: started sim, will post summary link when done.
legal: I'll sign off on clause after maya shares exact wording.
maya: OK locking plan tomorrow EOD unless objections. Speak now if you have one.
omar: no objections.
lucy: no objections.
ben: SRE approves pending sim numbers.
alia: sales aligned.
maya: Thanks everyone, I'll schedule the sign-off call and upload the pilot terms.
